name: Monta Payment Reconciliation
brief: Custom API surface for an external agent to register and post incoming customer payments, feeding Continia bank reconciliation.
description: Monta Payment Reconciliation exposes a focused set of custom APIs that let an external AI agent register and post incoming customer payments in Business Central, feeding Continia Statement Intelligence's bank-statement reconciliation. Targets Business Central 2026 wave 1 (v28).
